subject: Krystle Campbell Peace Garden Unveiling
overview: The City of Medford held a dedication ceremony for the Krystle Campbell Peace Garden to honor the victims of the 2013 Boston Marathon bombing. Officials, family members, and survivors provided remarks on the community's resilience and the garden's role as a place for reflection and peace.

items.title: Ceremonial opening and presentation of colors
items.summary: Host Lisa Hughes introduced the ceremony, followed by the presentation of colors by the Medford Police, MIT, and Middlesex County Sheriff's honor guards.

items.title: Pledge of Allegiance and National Anthem
items.summary: Members of the Medford Little League led the Pledge of Allegiance, followed by the National Anthem performed by Stacey Clayton.

items.title: Moment of silence
items.summary: The assembly observed a moment of silence in memory of victims Crystal Campbell and Sean Collier.

items.title: Invocation
items.summary: Mark O'Connell offered a prayer for the victims, the injured, and the first responders.

items.title: Remarks by Secretary of Transportation Stephanie Pollack
items.summary: Secretary Pollack discussed the collaboration involved in constructing the garden as a physical manifestation of remembrance.

items.title: Poetic interlude
items.summary: Fuat Memelli read a poem dedicated to Crystal Campbell and the healing of the community.

items.title: Remarks by BAA Race Director Dave McGillivray
items.summary: McGillivray shared stories of survivors' recovery and presented his 2013 Boston Marathon medal to the Campbell family.

items.title: Musical performance
items.summary: Stacey Clayton performed a song titled "Peace is for Everyone."

items.title: Remarks by Former Mayor Michael McGlynn
items.summary: McGlynn described the vision for the garden and recognized the donors who contributed nearly $1.5 million to the project.

items.title: Remarks by Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke
items.summary: Mayor Burke spoke about the garden as a living memorial and a testament to the community's inner strength.

items.title: Remarks by U.S. Senator Ed Markey
items.summary: Senator Markey highlighted the spirit of the victims and characterized the garden as a response to hatred.

items.title: Unveiling of memorial plaques and remarks by Mayor Marty Walsh
items.summary: Following the unveiling of plaques for Lingzi Lu and Martin Richard, Boston Mayor Marty Walsh spoke about the resilience of the Commonwealth.

items.title: Unveiling of Crystal Campbell plaque and remarks by Roseann Sdoia
items.summary: The Campbell family unveiled Crystal's plaque, followed by remarks from bombing survivor Roseann Sdoia regarding the significance of the garden's symbols.

items.title: Closing remarks and benediction
items.summary: Bill Campbell thanked the community for their support, and Braham David provided a final prayer for peace.
